header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: ﷺ said, as Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) has narrated.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The meaning of “Allah Ta'ala will pay it off on his behalf” is that Allah Ta'ala will help him to pay off the debt, and if he is unable to pay it off in his lifetime, He will pay it off on his behalf in the Hereafter”. The meaning of “Allah Ta'ala will ruin his wealth” is that because of this evil intention he will suffer loss of life or property.
(Fath al-Bari)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: كَانَ اللهُ مَعَ الدَّائِنِ حَتَّي يَقْضِيَ دَيْنَهُ مَالَمْ يَكُنْ فِيْمَا يَكْرَهُ اللهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ماجه باب من ادّي دينا وهو ينوي قضاءه رقم:٢٤٠٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Ja'far (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “As long as the debtor has not taken the loan for things that Allah dislikes, Allah Ta'ala is with the debtor until he pays off the debt.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: اِسْتَقْرَضَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ سِنًّا، فَاَعْطَي سِنًّا فَوْقَهُ، وَقَالَ: خِيَارُكُمْ مَحَاسِنُكُمْ قَضَاءً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب جواز اقتراض الحيوان ...رقم:٤١١١
blocks.tamil_translation: “Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) says: “The Prophet ﷺ had borrowed a camel. Then, when repaying the loan, he gave a camel older than it, and said: “The best of you is the one who repays a debt in the finest manner when repaying it.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ اَبِيْ رَبِيْعَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: اِسْتَقْرَضَ مِنِّي النَّبِيُّ ﷺ
